_meta.purpose: Items ruled out, with the reason. Feed this list as an exclusion set on future research runs so agents dig past ground already covered.

reasonCodes.too-obvious: Common knowledge chase item. Fails the 'wait, THAT is worth something' test.
reasonCodes.fixed-value-known: Well-known unique with a fixed roll, no surprise, seasoned players price it in their sleep.
reasonCodes.cheap-base: Base item that is common or cheap to obtain. User asked to minimize bases to only the super rare.
reasonCodes.not-surprising-perfect: A perfect roll exists but nobody is surprised by its value.
reasonCodes.archetype-not-item: A generalization, not a specific documented item.
reasonCodes.mechanic-not-item: A game rule or interaction, useful as a teaching note but not a card on its own.
reasonCodes.removed: Bug or item no longer in the current game.
reasonCodes.niche-low: Real and somewhat obscure but not collector-tier value.
reasonCodes.user-flagged: User explicitly rejected this in review.
